output.text: Probe Lark reports receipt of seven pulses originating from beneath an icy ridge at 14:32:17 UTC. No surface image was obtained due to the camera shutter remaining closed, as confirmed by internal diagnostics. Signal analysis indicates a consistent interval between pulses, suggesting non-random emission. No visual data is available for correlation. A repeat listening pass is scheduled for 15:15:00 UTC to verify signal consistency and attempt surface imaging with shutter override. All systems nominal. Probe Lark.
